notes.title: v 1.0.1 released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here is a small update, the changes:
removed the difficulty (not initializing) bug
and added a new difficulty,
revamped the option menu,
Boss MaxHP modifier and open save menu options
are now in the option menu instead on the map,
add two more options for displaying battlebacks
(black border and symetrical fill).

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

ps: tested in very easy difficulty. Next game on the Clarent Saga is coming soon!

notes.title: Some small error but no update for now...
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

After playing the game again, I came across some design errors.

When the game starts, you have to choose your difficulty. When choosing, if you cancel the difficulty is not initialized. All the variables are at 0 and the switches are off. In short, in this mode you don't gain xp or gold, and you don't heal between fights. I don't think you can go very far in the game like that but it's a good easter egg (a hidden difficulty!) so I think I'll leave it. And if a player does it by mistake, it's easy to change the difficulty back later.

Second mistake, the battlebacks are not in the right resolution, which compress them. But after playing again a bit, it's not especially noticeable. So I won't update the game soon,

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

notes.title: v 0.84 released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here is a major update, the changes:
add script up to chapter 15 (out of 22),
greatly nerf all bosses HP (shorter battle),
all semi divine skills are now balanced,
added hit skill is now a divine skill renamed Radiant Blade II,
change some bosses magic attacks,
add experience ring.

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

ps: the script is available up to ch 17. I will take a short break and
update later.

notes.title: v 0.66 released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here is a major update, the changes:
bgm memorized when in the main map,
add library (items and equipment list) and bestiary in the extra zone,
revamped how accessories work (there are now 3 categories), can now equip:
2 rings, 4 special rings, and 1 subclass ring,
corrected battleback when loading from a savepoint,
changed starting equipment of character to scale with the current chapter,
greatly decrease ex bosses HP (fight are faster),
add 1 more difficulty.

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

note: old save may not work.

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here is a minor update. The changes:

Thief steal MP absorb 5% of damage dealt instead of 10%,
Thief Trade MP doesn't give you BP anymore,
Trader Paid Help now display the correct gold cost.

Thank you for your support,
David N.
